subject: Re: Post-discovery recap — lock 30m demo & confirm decision owner
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Lee <alice@clearbridgehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom@clearbridgehealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-11-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-discovery recap + next step: 30m demo

Hi Alice & Tom —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call (high level):

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for batch reports and enable low-cost interactive queries on patient notes.
- Current blockers: model serving cost at scale, and audit log visibility for PHI workflows.
- Success criteria we agreed on: < 200ms p95 for 2k qps equivalent, audit logs retained 12 months, and a pilot with 3 endpoints instrumented.

Next steps: schedule a 30-minute product demo oriented to your infra/ops and ML leads. Please pick one of these windows in PT:

1) Tue Nov 7 — 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed Nov 8 — 14:00–14:30 PT
3) Thu Nov 9 — 09:00–09:30 PT

Can you confirm which works (or propose two alternatives)? If you can, please also confirm who the decision owner will be for pilot approval so we invite the right folks.

I've looped Neha (solutions engineer) on this thread — she'll lead the technical deep dive during the demo. Attached: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (1pg), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stub).

Cheers,

Rachel Kim
Sales Director
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-brief.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (Excel)

From: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearbridgehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alice Lee <alice@clearbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + next step: 30m demo

Rachel —

Thanks for the recap. Wed Nov 8 14:00–14:30 PT works for us. I'll make sure Priya (procurement/decision owner) and our ML infra lead are available — I'll invite them once you confirm.

One ask: can the demo include a short section on audit/log exports and KMS integration? That's a blocker for our security team.

— Tom

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Perfect — locking Wed Nov 8 14:00–14:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite to everyone once we have the final attendee list.

Neha and Dylan are on the thread: Neha will cover integration and KMS/audit exports; Dylan will handle serving/runtime questions and latency tuning. If you expect anyone from SRE or procurement to ask about retention or compliance, please include them so we can tailor the short checklist.

I've attached a one-page pre-demo checklist to help scope the session (pre-demo-checklist.docx) and updated the mutual action plan with tentative milestones.

Action items for us:
- Rachel: send invite + invite notes + agenda (by EOD)
- Neha: prepare 5–7 minute demo subsection on KMS/audit exports
- Dylan: prepare a quick slide on latency tuning + recommended batch/cache settings

If Priya will be invited, can you confirm her email so I add her to the invite? Also, let me know if you'd like a 45-minute slot instead — we can expand to 45 if stakeholders want more time.

Thanks,

Rachel
Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.docx (DOCX)
